name: Hiding soul
description: a damned soul of the Ember Wastes, stuck in Hell's loop forever: a thin hunched bald human figure in a long ragged ash-grey shroud, pale ash-grey skin, hollow tired eyes, a soft pale blue-white glow around its outline, bare feet, crouched low behind a scrap of its own shroud pulled up to the eyes, a finger to its lips

poses.stand: crouched low, the shroud pulled up to its eyes

idle.action: rocks gently in place, breathing slowly

hiccup.action: peeks over the shroud, ducks, peeks again, trembling
